dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Amaru is at risk due to behavioral concerns in care. He has been observed repeatedly jumping on handlers, jumping on and off during walks, and pulling heavily on leash. In one instance Amaru was pulling excessively on the leash and jumping onto the handler, he jumped towards a passing staff member and grabbed onto their sweater sleeve, he was pulling and tugging on the sweater; when attempting to use an alternate object to redirect him Amaru turned and attempted to snap at the first handler. Staff reports kennel stress-related behaviors, jumping and barking at his kennel door. Amaru is noted to be social with handlers and enjoys being pet. Medically, Amaru is apparently healthy.

Amaru came into ACC as a stray. Because of this, we do not know how he is in a home environment. During his time in the care center he has been observed repeatedly jumping on handlers, jumping on and off during walks, and pulling heavily on leash. In one instance Amaru was pulling excessively on the leash and jumping onto the handler, he jumped towards a passing staff member and grabbed onto their sweater sleeve, he was pulling and tugging on the sweater; when attempting to use an alternate object to redirect him Amaru turned and attempted to snap at the first handler. Amaru is noted to be social with handlers and enjoys being pet.

A Volunteer Wrote: We are all so charmed by this amazing goofball, who is so great on a leash and up for absolutely any adventure, especially if it involves going to the park and being pet, getting treats, and sitting on your feet to watch the world in action (he showed no responsiveness to passing dogs.) If I stopped petting him he would gently lick my hand to let me know I was failing in my duties. My real duty: Convincing someone to come to the shelter and taking this wonderful, giant-hearted boy home for a life time of pets and romping!

Amaru is a cheerful, gorgeous, and affectionate pup who loves to lean in for snuggly pets and give big kisses. While he can pull hard on the leash initially, he settles down quickly and is an excellent walker in a harness. Most notably, he is completely calm and non-reactive to other dogs, people, or vehicles, making him a silly, sweet, and easy-to-manage companion who is ready for a forever home where he can run and play.
dog.name: Amaru
